items.q: she was telling me that she knew an Indian doctor that was very good at ...(?).

ctx.x: When did you start having the physical trouble?

Oh, that was last year. That's when my legs started to hurt. Then I went to Senior Citizens Clinic uptown, and I ran across this doctor there, a (?) doctor... Anyway, she was telling me that she knew an Indian doctor that was very good at ...(?).
Because they realized that was circulation, it was coming from the heart.
